Job Description – Manager – Indirect Taxation (GST)

Hiring on behalf of: Our reputed Chartered Accountancy (CA) Firm Client

Qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA)

Experience: 6+ Years of Post-Qualification Experience

Team Management: 15–20 Professionals

Specialisation: GST, Indirect Taxation, Advisory & Litigation

Job Summary

We are hiring on behalf of our reputed CA firm client for a qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) with 6+ years of post-qualification experience in Indirect Taxation, particularly GST advisory, statutory compliance, and litigation.

The ideal candidate should possess strong technical expertise, client management capabilities, and leadership skills, with the ability to lead and manage a team of 15–20 professionals while ensuring effective service delivery and regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities
• Review GST returns, tax liabilities, refund applications, and GST registration processes to ensure accuracy and compliance.
• Handle GST notices, litigation, assessments, and represent or coordinate with GST authorities.
• Provide advisory services to clients on GST, indirect taxation, and foreign trade policies.
• Monitor changes in tax laws, rules, and regulations and ensure timely implementation and compliance.
• Identify potential tax risks, support tax audits, and manage assessment-related matters.
• Develop and maintain strong client relationships while providing effective and practical tax solutions.
• Lead, mentor, and evaluate team members and trainees to ensure productivity and professional development.
• Develop and implement SOPs, streamline processes, and drive operational efficiency.
• Prepare and review MIS reports, periodic updates, and performance reports for partners and senior management.

Required Skills & Competencies
• Strong knowledge of GST laws, rules, and regulations.
• Experience in GST compliance, advisory, and litigation.
• Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Office, and relevant accounting and tax software.
• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, client-handling, and team-management skills.
• Strong leadership and decision-making abilities.
• Ability to manage multiple assignments, prioritise deliverables, and meet deadlines.

Candidate Profile
• Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA).
• Minimum 6 years of post-qualification experience.
• Strong exposure to GST advisory, compliance, assessments, and litigation.
• Experience in managing and leading a team of 15–20 professionals.
• Ability to independently manage client engagements and provide technical guidance to the team.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will receive a screening call from our team.

Senior Treasury Accountant

AB Finco — International In-House Bank | Cencora

Business Unit

Cencora International Controlling — ABFinco Operations

Treasury Accounting Lead

Senior Accountant

Permanent, Full-Time

Group Treasury, Accounting, Tax, Legal, IT, Shared Service Centre and Banking Partners

ABOUT CENCORA & ABFINCO

Cencora (formerly AmerisourceBergen) is a Fortune 10 global pharmaceutical distribution and solutions company operating in more than 65 countries. ABFinco is Cencora’s international in-house bank, providing central cash pooling, foreign exchange and intercompany funding services to international businesses including Alliance Healthcare, World Courier and PharmaLex. ABFinco manages exposures in more than 10 active currencies.

ROLE PURPOSE

The Senior Treasury Accountant will deliver accurate, timely and well-controlled accounting for ABFinco’s foreign exchange, intercompany lending and cash activities. The role owns treasury accounting from transaction capture in Kyriba through posting and reconciliation in SAP, leads the monthly close, and provides quality review and technical support to Shared Service Centre Treasury Analysts. Reporting to the Treasury Accounting Lead, the role will also strengthen controls, reporting and processes as the in-house treasury accounting function develops.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Treasury Accounting and Close

· Own accounting for FX, hedging, cash and intercompany treasury transactions in Kyriba and SAP.

· Review treasury entries, valuations and interest accruals.

· Lead the monthly close and deliver accurate management accounts and treasury reporting between workday 1 and workday 3.

· Reconcile Kyriba to SAP, resolve differences and maintain complete supporting documentation.

· Support hedge-accounting calculations, statutory reporting, Group consolidation and internal and external audits.

Intercompany Loans and Cash

· Oversee accounting and reconciliation for intercompany loans, cash pools and Group funding balances across 102 entities.

· Review loan interest, reference rates and margins against agreements and transfer-pricing requirements.

· Prepare and review loan, cash and bank reconciliation reports.

Controls and Systems

· Operate treasury-accounting controls, maintain audit evidence and support control testing.

· Maintain treasury-system master data and support Kyriba-to-SAP interfaces, reporting and process improvements.

· Support regulatory reporting and ensure transactions comply with internal policies and segregation-of-duties requirements.

Team and Stakeholder Support

· Act as the subject matter expert and escalation point for Shared Service Centre Treasury Analysts.

· Work with Treasury, Accounting, Tax, Legal, IT, banking partners and international finance teams to resolve issues and support change.

PROFILE & SKILLS

Essential

· Chartered Accountant, Cost and Management Accountant, ACCA or equivalent finance qualification, with 4–7 years of relevant treasury accounting experience.

· Practical experience of month-end close, reconciliations, FX accounting and intercompany accounting.

· Hands-on experience with an ERP or treasury management system; SAP or Kyriba exposure is preferred.

Strong analytical, reconciliation and control skills, with attention to detail in a multi-entity, multi-currency environment.

· Clear communication and stakeholder-management skills across Treasury, Finance, Tax, Legal and IT.

· Ability to review work, coach colleagues and manage priorities in a Shared Service Centre environment.

Preferred

· Experience in a multinational treasury, in-house bank or treasury shared-services environment.

· Knowledge of cash pooling, intercompany funding and hedge accounting under IFRS 9 or ASC 815.

· Exposure to Kyriba, SAP, Bloomberg, or trade-confirmation platforms.

· Treasury qualification or relevant professional development is desirable.

.
Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or a related field, or equivalent experience required.

4+ years of experience in accounting, financial operations, reconciliations, close support, reporting support, or a related field required.

Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Chartered Accountant (CA), Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA), Certified Management Accountant (CMA), or equivalent certification preferred.

Knowledge of accounting principles, including cost accounting and financial statement analysis.
Working knowledge of accounting software and ERP systems; SAP experience is preferred.
Ability to create clear, user-tailored financial reports.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.
Strong mathematical, analytical, and fact-based analysis skills with attention to detail.
Strong written, verbal, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
Demonstrates management and supervisory skills.
Ability to implement processes that support satisfactory audit practices.
Knowledge of contract and chargeback processes, credit and collection principles, and business law.
Ability to work independently and handle stressful situations.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Title: Chief Accountant R2R

Reports to: Process Delivery Manager R2R

Role Type: Team Manager/Individual contributor

Location: Chinchwad, Pune

Job Roles & Responsibilities:

Responsible for managing and ensuring accurate, compliant, and timely financial reporting for one or more legal entities within the sub-region. The role supports statutory, regulatory, and corporate governance requirements while partnering closely with the CFO, Company Finance Manager, auditors, and key business stakeholders to deliver high-quality financial reporting and control.

Key Tasks & Responsibilities

Financial Reporting & Close Management

- Coordinate and oversee month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing activities for assigned legal entities.

- Ensure timely and accurate financial reporting in compliance with IFRS, Ind AS, local GAAP, Companies Act requirements, and Group accounting policies.

- Review journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, and financial statements to ensure completeness and accuracy.

- Support consolidation and reporting requirements for group and management reporting.

Statutory & Regulatory Compliance

- Prepare and coordinate statutory financial statements in collaboration with the Company Finance Manager.

- Ensure compliance with Companies Act, SEBI regulations, stock exchange reporting requirements, and other applicable statutory regulations.

- Coordinate filing requirements, disclosures, and regulatory submissions related to listed entity obligations.

- Monitor changes in accounting standards and regulatory requirements and drive implementation as required.

Governance, Controls & Audit

- Ensure compliance with corporate governance requirements and internal control frameworks, including IFC/SOX (where applicable).

- Coordinate internal, statutory, tax, and regulatory audits and serve as the key finance contact for auditors.

- Drive timely closure of audit observations and implementation of corrective actions.

- Support risk assessment and control monitoring activities across the reporting process.

Business Partnering & Stakeholder Management

- Act as the primary finance interface for the Company Finance Manager, CFO, Corporate Finance, and external stakeholders.

- Partner with business teams to provide financial insights, accounting guidance, and reporting support.

- Support Board, Audit Committee, and leadership reporting requirements through preparation of high-quality financial analyses and presentations.

Performance Reporting & Continuous Improvement

- Support CFO and senior management with profitability analysis, margin reviews, working capital reporting, and quarterly board packs.

- Drive process standardization, automation, and reporting improvements through SKF Business Excellence and digital initiatives.

- Lead initiatives focused on improving reporting quality, compliance, efficiency, and control effectiveness.

- Actively contribute to finance transformation projects, ERP enhancements, and process optimization initiatives.

Experience

- Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA).

- 15+ years of progressive experience in Finance, Accounting, and Controllership functions.

- Demonstrated experience within:

- Financial Accounting & Reporting

- Financial Controlling

- Statutory Compliance

- Audit Management

- Corporate Governance

- Listed Company Reporting Environment

Competency Profile

- Solid experience in a listed company environment.

- In-depth knowledge of Ind AS, IFRS, Companies Act, and regulatory reporting requirements.

- Strong understanding of financial close, consolidation, and statutory reporting processes.

- Experience managing internal and external audits.

- Knowledge of Internal Financial Controls (IFC) and governance frameworks.

- Strong analytical, stakeholder management, and business partnering skills.

- Proven ability to identify and implement process improvements.

- Advanced ERP knowledge (SAP/S4HANA preferred).

- Strong communication, presentation, and board-reporting capabilities.

Role Success Criteria

- Timely and accurate financial, statutory, and regulatory reporting.

- Zero material audit findings and strong compliance adherence.

- Effective stakeholder engagement with CFO, auditors, and business leadership.

- Continuous improvement in reporting quality, controls, and automation.

- Demonstrates ownership, accountability, collaboration, and a strong team-first mindset.

- Supports the organization in maintaining high standards of governance expected of a listed entity.

We are seeking a qualified Chartered Accountant with 5-8 years of relevant experience to join our Consolidation team. The ideal candidate will support the end-to-end consolidation process for the group, ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting across multiple entities. The role will involve consolidated financial reporting, foreign currency (FX) translation, goodwill calculation and accounting, Oracle/FCCS consolidation activities, and topside adjustment management. The candidate will also contribute to strengthening internal controls, improving consolidation processes, supporting audits, and ensuring key reporting deliverables are IPE compliant. This position requires strong technical accounting knowledge combined with effective stakeholder management, with regular interaction across regional controllers, entity finance teams, auditors, and other cross-functional stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:
• Support the monthly, quarterly, and annual consolidation process for multiple global entities within the group using Oracle FCCS.
• Assist in timely and accurate preparation and review of consolidated financial statements out of Oracle FCCS and related reporting deliverables.
• Coordinate with regional controllers, External Reporting and Tax team to gather any financial information or supporting documentation as needed and also address any queries that they may have from time to time.
• Perform monthly goodwill reconciliation to ensure that workings are accurate, including acquisition-related adjustments, FX, or any other adjustments.
• Perform inter-company elimination review of dividends and investment/equity balances and resolve the differences by working with controllers.
• Prepare and monitor topside journal entries in Oracle/FCCS, including preparation/posting, validation, and appropriate supporting documentation.
• Review foreign currency (FX) translation of subsidiary financial statements, including validation of exchange rates, translation adjustments, and related consolidation impacts.
• Support in preparation and compilation of variance/flux analysis commentaries of consolidated BS and PL.
• Assist in designing, implementing, and strengthening SOX controls and IPE documentation over the consolidation and Financial Statement Close Process (FSCP).
• Support timely resolution and closure of internal and external audit queries relating to consolidation, controls, and supporting documentation.
• Drive close acceleration by collaborating with key stakeholders, including regional controllers, on a continuous basis.
• Perform sub-consolidations for tax purposes and address any ad-hoc data queries received from time to time.
• Participate in ad hoc assignments, automation initiatives, system enhancements, and other consolidation/process-improvement projects.

Requirements:
• Qualified CA/CPA with 5-8 years of relevant experience, with significant exposure to financial consolidation and GAAP reporting, preferably US GAAP.
• Strong knowledge of the complete consolidation cycle and concepts including intercompany eliminations, FX, goodwill, acquisition accounting, etc.
• Strong understanding of internal/SOX controls for FSCP process.
• Exposure to consolidation tools like Hyperion, Oracle/FCCS, Tagetik, etc.
• Proficiency in MS Office, with advanced Excel skills.
• Working knowledge of ERP systems like SAP, QAD, etc.
• Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and collaborate effectively in a dynamic environment.
• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to effectively communicate, collaborate, and influence stakeholders across teams and geographies.
• Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

Job Title: Head – Finance & Accounts (Chartered Accountant)

Location: Pune – MH

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience Level: 10–15 years

About the Company

DDE ULTRA is a pioneering provider of ultra-high purity process utility systems serving the semiconductor, PV Solar and other high-tech industries. We specialize in designing, manufacturing and installing complex utility systems and turnkey solutions.

We are seeking an Experienced Chartered Accountant (CA) to independently lead the complete Finance & Accounts function, ensuring financial control, compliance, accurate reporting, effective cost management and sound financial decision-making.

Key Responsibilities
• Take end-to-end ownership of accounting, finance operations, monthly and annual book closures, and finalization of accounts.
• Prepare and review financial statements, cash-flow reports, MIS and management dashboards, present key financial insights to senior management.
• Lead annual budgeting, periodic budget forecasting and financial planning across departments and projects.
• Conduct budget-versus-actual variance analysis, investigate deviations and recommend corrective actions.
• Manage cost control and optimization, including project costs, material, manpower, overheads and operating expenses; monitor cost overruns and profitability.
• Oversee cash flow, working capital, fund planning, receivables, payables, banking relationships and facilities such as BGs and LCs, wherever applicable.
• Manage direct and indirect taxation, including GST, TDS and income tax, ensuring timely filings, reconciliations and resolution of notices.
• Lead statutory, internal and tax audits; coordinate with auditors and consultants and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
• Oversee project accounting, project-wise costing, billing, revenue recognition, work-in-progress, retention and profitability reporting.
• Establish and strengthen financial policies, internal controls, approval mechanisms, accounting procedures and compliance calendars.
• Lead and guide the Accounts & Finance team, review deliverables and ensure timely and accurate completion of activities.
• Coordinate with projects, procurement, stores, HR, sales and other teams on budgets, costs, collections, payments and financial matters.

Technical Skills
• Strong knowledge of accounting standards, financial reporting, finalization of accounts and taxation.
• Expertise in budgeting, forecasting, budget-versus-actual variance analysis and cost management.
• Strong understanding of cash flow, treasury, working capital, project costing and profitability analysis.
• Hands-on experience in GST, TDS, income tax, statutory compliance and audit management.
• Knowledge of internal financial controls, risk management and financial process improvement.
• Proficiency in ERP / SAP / Tally and advanced MS Excel; ability to prepare MIS and management reports.

If you are GREAT in the above, not just good, then we need you in our Team.

Qualifications & Skills
• Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI).
• 10–15 years of relevant post-qualification experience in Finance & Accounts, preferably in engineering, manufacturing, EPC or project-based organizations.
• Demonstrated ability to independently manage the complete finance function, including accounting, taxation, audits, banking and statutory compliance.
• Proven experience in annual budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, cost control and project profitability management.
• Experience in financial reporting, cash-flow and working-capital management, internal controls and team leadership.
• Strong analytical, decision-making, communication and stakeholder-management skills, with high integrity and accountability.

Preferred Industry Background
• Engineering, manufacturing and industrial organizations.
• Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) companies.
• Project-based engineering, infrastructure and turnkey solution providers.
• Semiconductor, PV Solar, process engineering and industrial utility industries.

Additional Information
• This is a senior-level role with independent ownership of the organization's Finance & Accounts function.
• The candidate must combine hands-on financial management with leadership-level planning, reporting and decision support.
• Experience in managing finance for a growing engineering, manufacturing or EPC business will be an advantage.

Ready to take your career global?

Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for an Associate Financial Reporting Analyst to join our ever-evolving Stat reporting Team and help us unleash the potential of every business.

What You’ll Own

• Preparation of annual statutory accounts for respective legal entities in accordance with local GAAP.
• Co-ordinate the audits with local Audit firms in order to complete and file the accounts by filing due
• dates.
• Preparation of schedules/reconciliations for audit.
• Provide all support as requested by auditors
• Work with BU, Legal, corporate, treasury, HR, payroll to obtain documents/information/approvals
• etc. as required for audits
• Preparation of Financial statements (FS) and disclosures as required
• Liaising with Tax/ Corporate/External Advisors to facilitate the completion of tax returns by filing
• deadlines
• Work to address queries from Director during FS review to obtain approvals
• Work with Tax team to obtain approvals on tax workings and disclosures
• Book all stat adjustments in accounting system and ensure it agrees to local statutory accounts and perform regular retained earnings reconciliations.

What You Bring

• CA (Chartered Accountant) Fully Qualified – Fresher/0-1 year of experience
• Good accounting knowledge and stat audit experience during article ship period
• Strong communication skills.
• Ability to deliver output under pressure with accuracy and eye for detail
• Willingness to learn & grow
• Demonstrates flexibility in response to changes in the process

Our inclusive and global teams win together every day. We’re proud to have the best minds in the industry, who you can learn from as you grow your career. The people, the energy, the connections – it’s unmatched. Come and be part of an ever-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.

Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative – always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.

About the Company:

Established in 1978, M S K A & Associates is an Indian partnership firm registered with the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) and the PCAOB (US Public Company Accountancy Oversight Board). A member firm of BDO International that offers a range of Assurance services, led by 80+ Partner & Directors and 1900+ staff across 11 cities - Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, Chandigarh, Goa, Hyderabad, Kochi, Kolkata, Mumbai, Gurugram, and Pune. Having extensive experience, knowledge and industry foresight, our experts deliver robust, transparent and technology-driven services and provide bespoke solutions to clients. Our portfolio includes services like Statutory, Ind AS Conversion, IFC, Tax, Accounting Manual, Limited Review, Group Reporting, Certification and Capital Market Support. About TRA Leveraging our global expertise and experience, our team of subject matter experts and industry professionals work across sectors and industries to help our clients respond to the changing business environment. With deep analytic skills and state-of-the art technologies, our professionals deliver customised and innovative solutions to clients across geographies. We at BDO, engage in transforming data into insights, our professionals guide clients through a crisis, fraud, regulatory investigations, etc. and advise them on strategies to prevent and mitigate the disruption arising from these complex matters.

• Ability to prioritize, work on multiple assignments, and manage ambiguity.

• Should be open and honest in communication with clients and colleagues.
• Fluency in written & verbal English.
• Managing engagement teams for optimum delivery, ability to articulate findings and convincing mid to senior level client management and coaching & mentoring staff on the engagements.
